decisions.reason: Its dedicated pages in both years show the firm can interpret early results because the aloe vera line builds on its existing chemical and botanical extraction knowledge.
The serum has only been mentioned without a dedicated page, indicating the firm struggles to assimilate market feedback and lacks the commercial cosmetic knowledge to improve it further.
The cleansing oil is close to the firm's surfactant formulation capabilities and likely benefits from learning after the discontinued cleansing milk, so it retains absorptive-capacity value.
